commands.name: godmode
commands.description: Switch godmode on: a PM main thread that files tickets and dispatches dev and review agents (`setup` to change the setup, `off`, `report`, `try <ticket>`)

tools.name: ticket_create
tools.description: File a new ticket in the project's tracker. Filing never starts work. Tickets are read and changed only through the ticket tools, never by editing files.

tools.name: ticket_move
tools.description: Change a ticket's status (todo, doing, review, done) or header: branch, PR, blockers, visible change. `ready` marks a ticket the person said go for; only the main thread may set it.

tools.name: ticket_list
tools.description: List tickets, headers only (id, status, ready, title, blockers, branch, PR). By default every ticket not done.

tools.name: ticket_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket: a finding, a verdict, a decision. Comments are kept in order under the ticket.

tools.name: review_verdict
tools.description: Record your review verdict on a PR, at its current head commit: clean, change-request or blocker. Only a reviewer agent records one. A PR is marked ready or merged only with a clean verdict at its current commit, so a new commit needs a new review.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
